description: Become proactive and solution oriented. No one can live your life for you #freedom #selflove #selfcare
transcript: I am very proactive in my life. There is a solution for everything and I will always find it. Didn't people are stuck? Yes, there's always going to be bills, there's always going to be family things, there's always going to be job things, relationship things, there's always things. That is not what we are talking about. We are talking about cultivating your internal world. We are talking about creating a world where you thrive. There is a solution for everything if you dig deep enough.
